quiz_item.question: While adjusting a jammed spur-gear drive train in the robotics lab, a Scout notices white dry residue from a damaged battery cell and has a minor sheet-metal cut on a forearm. What safety and first-aid procedure does the Robotics Merit Badge Pamphlet require?
options: A. Leave the battery connected so the servo motors hold torque while clearing the jammed gear teeth with bare fingers.

B. Wear ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses, disconnect the main battery before touching drive gears, brush off dry battery or flux chemicals with a gloved hand before flushing, and wash minor cuts with soap and running water for 5 minutes.
C. Pour water directly onto dry battery powder with bare hands and wrap the unwashed cut with electrical tape.
D. Remove safety glasses for a closer view of the spinning pinion gear while toggling the transmitter stick.

patrol_quiz_bank.scenario_prompt: While adjusting a jammed spur-gear drive train in the robotics lab, a Scout notices white dry residue from a damaged battery cell and has a minor sheet-metal cut on a forearm. What safety and first-aid procedure does the Robotics Merit Badge Pamphlet require?
patrol_quiz_bank.question: While adjusting a jammed spur-gear drive train in the robotics lab, a Scout notices white dry residue from a damaged battery cell and has a minor sheet-metal cut on a forearm. What safety and first-aid procedure does the Robotics Merit Badge Pamphlet require?
options: A. Leave the battery connected so the servo motors hold torque while clearing the jammed gear teeth with bare fingers.

B. Wear ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses, disconnect the main battery before touching drive gears, brush off dry battery or flux chemicals with a gloved hand before flushing, and wash minor cuts with soap and running water for 5 minutes.
C. Pour water directly onto dry battery powder with bare hands and wrap the unwashed cut with electrical tape.
D. Remove safety glasses for a closer view of the spinning pinion gear while toggling the transmitter stick.
choices: A. Leave the battery connected so the servo motors hold torque while clearing the jammed gear teeth with bare fingers.

B. Wear ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses, disconnect the main battery before touching drive gears, brush off dry battery or flux chemicals with a gloved hand before flushing, and wash minor cuts with soap and running water for 5 minutes.
C. Pour water directly onto dry battery powder with bare hands and wrap the unwashed cut with electrical tape.
D. Remove safety glasses for a closer view of the spinning pinion gear while toggling the transmitter stick.
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: B. Wear ANSI Z87.1 safety glasses, disconnect the main battery before touching drive gears, brush off dry battery or flux chemicals with a gloved hand before flushing, and wash minor cuts with soap and running water for 5 minutes.
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (B): Per the Robotics Merit Badge Pamphlet (pp. 9-12), always wear ANSI Z87.1 eye protection, disconnect battery power before mechanical adjustments, brush dry chemical residue away with a gloved hand before flushing with water, and flush minor cuts with soap and water for 5 minutes before applying a sterile bandage.

patrol_quiz_bank.scenario_prompt: Why does the Robotics merit badge pamphlet compare an autonomous robot system to the human autonomic nervous system?
patrol_quiz_bank.question: Why does the Robotics merit badge pamphlet compare an autonomous robot system to the human autonomic nervous system?
options: A. Both systems require continuous manual joystick input from an external operator
B. Both operate and regulate themselves automatically through an internal controller without conscious interference
C. Both rely exclusively on pneumatic tubes rather than electrical signals
D. Both can only perform a single physical motion before shutting down permanently
choices: A. Both systems require continuous manual joystick input from an external operator
B. Both operate and regulate themselves automatically through an internal controller without conscious interference
C. Both rely exclusively on pneumatic tubes rather than electrical signals
D. Both can only perform a single physical motion before shutting down permanently
patrol_quiz_bank.correct_answer: B. Both operate and regulate themselves automatically through an internal controller without conscious interference
patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (B): Just as the human autonomic nervous system regulates involuntary functions like heartbeat on its own, an autonomous robot uses its onboard computer controller to operate and regulate itself without continuous human interference (p. 16).

choices: A. Human-robot interface

patrol_quiz_bank.explanation: Correct Answer (C): Manipulation covers the parts of a robot that physically interact with objects to touch them, pick them up, place them in containers, or apply materials like paint, whereas mobility covers moving from place to place (p. 15).
